# DuoWallpaper

> DuoWallpaper is a free wallpaper app for iPhone Duo that saves matched cover and inner screen sets at exact pixel sizes, with no ads and no data collected.

- App Store name: DuoWallpaper: Foldable Walls
- Price: free. No ads, no account, no in-app purchases, no data collected.
- 250 original wallpapers in 22 collections.
- Sizes (Apple spec): cover 1398 x 2034; inner 1878 x 2670, exported wide 2670 x 1878 or upright 1878 x 2670.
- Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6826296293
